messages.subject: multiple selectInputs with choices dependent of each other (i.e. showing only choices not selected)
parts:
Ok, seems like this one should be easy but seems like I can't figure it out. Not sure if this is been asked before, but I can't seem to find any info on this issues.

The issue is quite simple. I want to have multiple selectInput drop boxes with choices showing only what as not been selected in the other drop boxes. i.e. dropbox that will adjust their choices in relation with the choices made in the other dropbox. I have yet to find a strategy that will stop the recursion... Any how, let me know if someone has found a solution. Here is my pitiful attempt at the problem using only two drop boxes. 

thanks in advance

## server.R
library(shiny)

shinyServer(function(input, output) {

    myValue <- paste0("Value-",1:9)
    
    value <- reactiveValues(selected=NULL)
    
    observe({
        inputs <- grep("^input_",names(input),value=TRUE)
        selection <- sapply(inputs, function(id) input[[id]])
        isolate( value$selected <- selection)
    })
    
    observe ({
        rest <- myValue[!myValue %in% value$selected]
        output$pairSelector <- renderUI({
            list(selectInput("input_1",
                             "input_1",
                             rest),
                 selectInput("input_2",
                             "input_2",
                             rest)
                 )
        })
    })
})

library(shiny)

shinyUI(fluidPage(
    uiOutput("pairSelector")
    ))
